summary: Rabbi Tawil examines the political consolidation of Shlomo Hamelech as he addresses threats to his reign in Melachim I Chapter 2. The class focuses on Shlomo's decisive actions against Adoniyahu and the banishment of Evyatar Hakohen, highlighting Shlomo's wisdom and his awareness of the political dynamics surrounding his throne.
questions: Why did Adoniyahu ask for Avishag HaShunamit?
Why did Shlomo decide to banish Evyatar instead of killing him?
What was the political significance of the king's mother in the royal court?
How did the history of Nov Ir HaKohanim influence Shlomo's decision regarding Evyatar?
